package.author: Sidekick-Poe
package.description: A Path of Exile and Path of Exile 2 companion tool

en-US.author: Sidekick-Poe
en-US.description: A Path of Exile and Path of Exile 2 companion tool
en-US.longDescription: A companion application for Path of Exile and Path of Exile 2. Open an item overlay to price check items, view your wealth, use chat commands, and more — without leaving the game.
en-US.name: Sidekick
en-US.releaseNotes:
Changes
- Fixed item class auto select condition missing item classes @JannSchippmann (#1281)
Features
- Added monster effectiveness and pack size filters @leMicin (#1279)
- Added item headers for runeforged and runemastered item results. @leMicin (#1275)
Bug Fixes
- Removed option to search in english trade results as it is way too inconsistent. We are planning on adding authentication to the Trade API to avoid issues for other languages. @leMicin (#1274)
Maintenance
- Cleaned up internal translation system @leMicin (#1280)
- Updated data files @leMicin (#1278)
Contributors
@JannSchippmann and @leMicin
